cc_message: We use cookies to ensure the website works, analyse traffic and personalise content. You can accept all, reject the optional ones or customise your settings.
cc_cat_pref_desc: They allow remembering preferences (language, theme, region).
cc_cat_analytics_desc: They help us understand how visitors use the site (traffic statistics).
cc_cat_marketing_desc: Used to display tailored ads and measure their effectiveness.
cc_enable_banner: Enable the consent banner on the site
cc_categories_hint: “Necessary” is always active. The other categories can be enabled/disabled.
cc_blocked_scripts_hint: Paste your analytics / marketing scripts here. They will be held (as type="text/plain") and run only after the matching consent is given. You can also manually mark your own tags with the data-cookieconsent="analytics|marketing|pref" attribute.
cc_scripts_marketing: Marketing scripts (e.g. Meta Pixel, Google Ads)
cc_consent_mode: Google Consent Mode v2 (default “denied”, updated after consent)
cc_respect_gpc: Respect Global Privacy Control / Do Not Sell (CCPA/CPRA)
cc_respect_dnt: Respect the Do Not Track (DNT) header
cc_show_revoke: Show the floating “Change consent” button (withdraw/change consent)
cc_log_enabled: Store consent records in the log (GDPR accountability)
cc_plugin_intro: This plugin blocks analytics and marketing scripts until consent is given. Compliant with GDPR, ePrivacy, CCPA/CPRA and Google Consent Mode v2.
